latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Subtitle Generator Software v1.0.0.
- Generate and burn in subtitles for video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB).
- Fast, cloud-based processing (typically 30–60 seconds per video) with automatic session and token management.
- Supports multi-language subtitles and exports 1080p MP4 files suitable for YouTube and social media.
- Includes error handling, session management, and user prompt routing for streamlined editing workflows.
- No local installation required—simply upload your video and specify subtitle instructions.
